The breakdown looks complete to me — I can see every part we agreed on has tasks behind it: the rich capture with automatic details and notes, the Read Later queue, tag-first organizing with collections as an extra, archive versus permanent delete, the precise search, saved searches, bulk actions with clear counts and confirmation, and keeping each person's library private and preserved. Nothing I asked for looks dropped, and import/export and page snapshots are held back for later as we agreed.

Starting with the setup, foundation, and the rich-capture story as a first testable milestone makes sense to me — I'd love to actually see saving a bookmark working end to end.

Please go ahead and begin the implementation.
